system.description: The Embrace has awakened within you an aspect of personality that others find particularly compelling. Choose one Background Trait from Allies, Black Hand Membership, Clan Prestige, Contacts, Fame, Herd, Influence, Mentor, Resources, Retainers, Sabbat Status, or Status. Your maximum rating in that Background may exceed the limit normally imposed by your generation by one dot (for example, a ninth-generation character could raise Resources to six). You may take this Merit for only one Background, and it should make sense for the character — a Camarilla archon is unlikely to have an unusually high Black Hand Membership, for example.
system.source: Clanbook: Ventrue, Chapter Two: The King is Dead, Long Live the King
